messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout rwd-2026-03-20-77 in eu-west-1 has hit abort conditions: sustained healthcheck failures + spike in streaming 5xx. Abort threshold: health_probe_failures >= 3 within 2m. Auto-abort initiated.

emma (on-call): I saw the PD page. Jumping in now, will grab traces and check canary pool state.

ryan: Observing a sharp increase in streaming connection resets and `socket_write_timeout` in the proxy logs. Affected sessions show repeated reconnects then 502. Pattern started ~00:03 UTC.

lee: CPU on model hosts is moderate, but disk io wait is high on one node (iowait ~80%). Looks like model shard swap plus heavy checkpointing. One container reported "failed liveness probe" shortly before evictions.

infra-bot: Alert details: alert_id=eu-canary-5xx-spike-20260320-77; severity=high; linked_incident=INC-4789.

emma (on-call): Quick mitigation: disable feature flag `enable-shard-reshard` for the rollout and spin down canary pool to force traffic back to stable. @ff-bot can you toggle?

ff-bot: Feature flag update: `enable-shard-reshard` removed for cohort=canary (actor=emma). Change propagated to edge config in ~18s.

ryan: After disabling the flag, we already see a drop in 5xx for non-streaming endpoints. Streaming endpoints still have some residual reconnects; might be stale connections.

lee: Running a manual `scale canary --pool eu-west-1 --to 0` to drain. Also marking the problematic host `eu-host-12` as unschedulable.

emma (on-call): Executing abort now.

deploy-bot: Rollout rwd-2026-03-20-77 abort requested by emma. Reverting to stable model variant v2.1.2 and restoring previous routing. Canary pool draining.

ryan: Example failing request (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
...chunks...
<last-chunk> -> connection reset by peer
```
Response: 502/504

lee: Collecting dmesg and container logs. Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-incident-archive/1973456789/. Will include kernel logs and docker stats.

cs-notify: Notifying customer success: short note queued to customers in impacted orgs. Template: "We experienced elevated errors for streaming endpoints in eu-west-1 during a canary rollout; we rolled back and are monitoring. Contact support if you saw issues."

emma (on-call): Current status: abort complete, traffic on stable. 5xx rate dropped from ~3.6% to ~0.4% within 2 minutes. Streaming reconnects decreasing.

ryan: Root-cause hypothesis: new shard-resharding path caused excessive checkpoint IO under certain traffic patterns leading to iowait and connection stalls. Requires deeper reproduction.

lee: Recommend blocking `enable-shard-reshard` in the rollout policy until eng-ml and infra can validate with a stress test. I'll open a bug with the perf traces.

emma (on-call): Scheduling postmortem: 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC. Participants: eng-runtime, eng-ml, infra, oncall. I'll draft the template and attach logs.

emma (on-call): Handoff: @ryan will watch the eu-west-1 metrics for 30m and escalate if regression. If no regressions, I'll close the incident in 45m. Thanks all for quick actions :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Incident INC-4789 transitioned to status=resolved (actor=emma). Notes: canary aborted; feature flag disabled for canary; artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-archive/1973456789/.

emma (on-call): Closing thread now. Reopen if anything reappears.
